title: Hardware Monitor
shortDescription: Read CPU, GPU, disk temperatures and usage via PawnIO/LibreHardwareMonitor; pin any reading to the Command Palette Dock.
description:
Hardware Monitor is a PowerToys Command Palette extension that samples real hardware sensors using PawnIO and LibreHardwareMonitor.

Features:
- Live CPU / GPU / storage temperatures, load, power, fans and more
- Pin any reading to the Dock (Compact and Default sizes)
- Sticky expand-only Y-axis trend charts (ASCII, not bitmap)
- Open a local offline HTML dashboard with Canvas charts
- Threshold highlighting for warm / hot / critical temperatures

Requires PowerToys Command Palette. Works best when PawnIO is installed.
